name: Jenga
summary: Jenga is a game of luck and skill.  Each player has to take it in turns to pull a block from the pile and place it on top of the tower.  The one who makes the tower fall down is the loser.  The game Jenga was invented by Leslie Scott in the 1970s and has become a popular game with children and adult
